title: Symplectic Weil Character on Semisimple Elements
body_html:
Symplectic Weil Character on Semisimple Elements

Let \((E,j)\) be a symplectic vector space over a finite field \(k\) of odd order \(q\), and let \(T\) be a maximal \(k\)-torus of the symplectic group \(S(E,j)\).

The restriction of \(W_\xi^{E,j}\) to \(T(k)\) factors over the block decomposition attached to the Galois orbits of the weights of \(T\). On each nonsymmetric block it is the corresponding rank-one general linear Weil representation, twisted by the block character \(x_\Omega^T\). On each symmetric block it is the corresponding rank-one unitary Weil representation, again twisted by \(x_\Omega^T\).

Consequently, if \(t\in S(E,j)\) is semisimple and \(T\) is a maximal \(k\)-torus containing \(t\), then \[ \operatorname{Tr} W_\xi^{E,j}(t) = (-1)^{\ell(E,T;t)} q^{N(E;t)} X_T(t), \] where \[ N(E;t)=\frac{1}{2}\dim_k\ker(t-1), \] \(\ell(E,T;t)\) is the number of Galois weight orbits on which \(t\) acts nontrivially, and \(X_T\) is the product of the block characters \(x_\Omega^T\).

This formula refines the fixed-point absolute value formula by specifying the sign and torus-character factor on semisimple elements.
